edit.label: Edit variation notes
edit.hint: Change, add or remove notes of the variation you hear; with no steps yet, this makes a variation by hand. Each edit is a step: Undo takes it back, and a Keep chip turns dashed when an edit changes what it keeps. The original notes are never changed.
roll.colourHint: Colour the notes by the next grouping that tells them apart
drawer.resize: Drag to make the piano roll taller or shorter; tap to put it away
roll.heading: Piano roll
edit.beginHint: Correct the notes on the roll: move, lengthen, add or take out notes. Nothing is kept until you save.
edit.title: Editing notes
edit.moveHint: Drag a note to move it; drag its end to change its length. The arrows move the note picked, Shift with ← → changes its length.
edit.addHint: Press where a note is missing to add one a sixteenth on the grid.
edit.deleteHint: Press a note to take it out. Delete or Backspace takes out the note picked.
edit.resetHint: Take every correction out: the notes as they were imported.
edit.keptOnSave: Nothing is kept until you save.
roll.expandHint: Open the selected passage as a piano roll across the screen
rollPick.hint: How Select picks notes: a box across time and pitch, or a lasso drawn round a melody over its accompaniment.
rollPick.label: Picking notes
roll.collapseHint: Puts the piano roll down; the roll button at the bottom brings it back.
